title: 6 AM. the negotiations begin.
summary: Low-poly story: at 6 AM he runs through his excuses (five more minutes, class is optional, skip breakfast) and ends up late again. So he gives his alarm one rule, no excuses: Unsnooze makes him do 15 squats and a memory game, and he's out the door on time.

beats.line: Excuse two: class is basically optional.
